phrases.es: I want to change money.
I've only got cash.
Where is the cash machine?
What's the exchange rate?
I want to take out money.
I want to pay in some money.
phrases.ru: Я хочу положить деньги на счёт.

phrases.es: What's my balance?
Where do I sign here?
Is there a fee?
I want to make a transfer.
I don't remember my PIN.
I need a bank statement.
Have you got savings accounts?
Where is the local branch?
I want to withdraw a hundred pounds.
My card is blocked.
I want to speak to the manager.
I want to open an account.
Can you lend me some money?
phrases.note: Lend — дать в долг, borrow — взять в долг: «Can I borrow some money?»

phrases.es: How much do I owe?
I'd like to invest my savings.
What is the interest rate?
In my opinion, it's a fraud.
We want to open a joint account.
I don't want to get into debt.
phrases.ru: Я не хочу влезать в долги.

phrases.es: I'd like to pay off part of the loan.
Is there a penalty for that?
Closing will only make the panic worse.
I think that's a good idea.
What if you tell the customers the truth?
Could you possibly show me the payments on this account?
phrases.ru: Не могли бы вы показать мне платежи по этому счёту?

phrases.es: Go on, show me the account.
Don't close the account, he is still using it.
phrases.ru: Не закрывайте счёт: он им ещё пользуется.

phrases.es: You may close it, those are the rules.
What if you leave it open for one more year?
phrases.ru: А если оставить его открытым ещё на год?
